root_policy_interpretation: Strict rejection of multiple physical roots; do not select a policy based on calibration or validation fit.
release_integration: One trapezoid of modeled endpoint release per nominal daily interval; input mean uses the current interval's full signed volume.
overflow: Explicit interval spill volume at capacity; operating endpoint release remains rule-consistent and spill is not carried as an endpoint-rate increment.
release_scoring: Daily observed total discharge versus modeled interval mean operating release plus interval spill volume divided by duration.
parameterization: Calibration-only masked storage and release percentiles using existing target_percentiles and quantile_method in the packaged reservoir configuration.
scores: Pooled eligible pairs within each phase; exclude warmup and provisional anchors.
